fistParagraph: Artina is the first market for creating, buying, selling and displaying nft in the Metaverse with Iranian currency in the world.
secondParagraph: Artina is a platform for buying and selling artworks in nft format with the approach of empowering artists to display and buy and sell their works. This product has made it possible for exhibitors and artists to create virtual exhibitions and buy and sell with currency and tomans.
thirdParagraph: Providing a safe, fast and easy platform for direct buying and selling of nft between buyer and seller.
foundation: The foundation of the Artina team
fourthParagraph: Artina was formed in the spring of 1401 with the aim of meeting the needs of Iranian users for the nft market. After the initial research and measuring the Iranian market's need for such a market, the initial core of the team was established in the growth center of Zanjan University. Gradually, with the addition of people with different specialties, the team grew.
